The Friction Bottlenecks & The Hybrid Breakthrough

SLIDE 2: IDEA TITLE & PROPOSED SOLUTION
Human Eye Flow & Psychology

Eye Flow: Left-to-right contrast. The evaluator immediately sees the pain point (broken red search) and is guided to the elegant solution (glowing green architecture diagram).

15-Second Speaker Hook

Currently, 63 million MSMEs struggle because keyword searches fail on colloquial terms, risking severe non-compliance penalties under Section 16 of the BIS Act. Our breakthrough fuses sparse lexical BM25 with dense semantic embeddings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, backed by a deterministic clause-level verification guard that guarantees 0% hallucination.

Evaluator Q&A Defense

Evaluator: 'Why not just use ChatGPT?' -> Answer: 'Generic LLMs hallucinate non-existent standard codes and fake clauses, creating immense legal liability. BIS-AI guarantees 0% hallucination because every output is deterministically grounded in official Gazette clauses.'

Slide 3

End-to-End Multimodal Neural Architecture & Production Pipeline

SLIDE 3: TECHNICAL APPROACH
Human Eye Flow & Psychology

Eye Flow: Numbers 1 through 5 guide the eye sequentially across the horizontal pipeline, proving deep software engineering thought and algorithmic competence.

15-Second Speaker Hook

Under the hood, we designed a zero-GPU, commodity CPU architecture. Our dual-stream pipeline runs parallel BM25 and ONNX bge-small embeddings, merged with RRF (k=60) and cross-encoder neural reranking. The entire 22,446 standards index fits in a sub-250MB Float32 RAM matrix, executing in 560 milliseconds.

Evaluator Q&A Defense

Evaluator: 'How does RRF work here?' -> Answer: 'Reciprocal Rank Fusion computes RRF(d) = sum(1 / (60 + r_m(d))) across lexical and semantic ranks. This eliminates the need for manual hyperparameter score weighting.'
